line: Four rows in my database started with "test_". Only three of them were real test data.
I told Claude Code to clean up the test data — it was cluttering everything.
That's the kind of instruction most tools would just follow, no questions asked.
This one didn't. It said one of those rows wasn't a fixture at all.
It was a real account, with a real balance, and real charges landing on that exact row every time.
So it kept one row, and removed the other three.
Claude Code comes with a normal Pro plan — twenty a month, nothing else to buy.
The exact setup's in the link in bio.
Follow for the setup that actually works.
